title: How long can voice sessions run?
content: The default hard limit is 8 minutes. Operators can configure the limit up to 15 minutes and the widget warns the user 60 seconds before cutoff.

title: How are API keys handled?
content: Google API keys are stored server-side only. The browser receives a short-lived ephemeral token plus a short-lived widget session token.

title: What happens if the microphone is denied?
content: The widget automatically falls back to text mode and continues the support conversation through the backend.
